results.content: The Information Network Security Administration (INSA) proudly marks the celebration of the 6th National Cybersecurity Month under the national theme “የሳይበር ደህንነት - የዲጂታል ኢትዮጵያ መሰረት፡ Cyber Security – The Foundation of Digital Ethiopia.” This year’s month-long awareness campaign focuses on strengthening Ethiopia’s digital security and resilience through nationwide engagement, educational programs, expert panel discussions, media campaigns, and awareness initiatives. As part of the National Cybersecurity Month, INSA invites all citizens, experts, and organizations to actively participate in our Cyber Awareness Games and Quizzes on the official event website: 👉 https://ncsm.insa.gov.et Together, let’s secure Ethiopia’s digital future — through awareness, collaboration, and innovation! Housed within ADGM Academy, the Cyber Arena will serve as a hub for: 🔹 Cutting-edge cybersecurity training and industry-recognised certifications 🔹 Advanced defence services and applied innovation 🔹 Collaboration between universities, start-ups, and research institutions In today’s complex digital landscape, empowering professionals and organisations with the right skills and tools has never been more important.
